title: Gas release in the cabin: ammonia 14 ppm
spokenText: Warning. Gas release in the crew cabin. Ammonia is at 14 parts per million. Put on your mask.

advice.why: Ammonia from the cooling loop irritates eyes and lungs, and in a closed cabin there is nowhere for it to go.
doNow: Put on your emergency mask now.
Move to the designated safe module and close the hatch.
Check each other for coughing or eye pain.
advice.escalate: Contact the flight surgeon now if anyone has trouble breathing, chest pain or eye pain. Mars comms delay can be up to 20 minutes, so act first.

disclaimer: AI-generated suggestion. Demo software, not a medical device.
